heroIntro:
Free, open source and local.
No login, no uploads, no complex settings.
stageCaption: Add a video. Choose quality. Convert.
stageAlt: MP4Flow in English, showing a local video conversion
proofOneBody: Copies compatible video without re-encoding. Uses hardware acceleration when available.
proofTwoBody: A lightweight app for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
proofThreeBody: Your videos stay on your Mac, from import to export.
toolsTitle:
The tools you need.
All in one app.
toolsIntro: Convert a file as it is, or make a few quick edits before exporting.
toolOneBody: Chooses how to create your MP4, avoiding re-encoding when possible.
toolTwoBody: Set the start and end points. Keep only the part you want.
toolThreeBody: Drag the frame or enter dimensions to remove unwanted edges.
toolFourBody: Turn video by 90° or 180° while keeping its proportions.
stepOneBody: Drop files in, or choose them in Finder.
stepTwoBody: Pick a quality. Trim, crop or rotate if needed.
stepThreeBody: Follow the progress, then open your video in Finder.
downloadBody:
Download the latest version, or build from source.
Free, open source, and right on your Mac.
footerTagline: Simple video tools. All on your Mac.
pageDescription: Convert, trim, crop and rotate video on your Mac. MP4Flow is free, open source and local. No login or uploads.
socialImageAlt: MP4Flow, a native Mac video converter
installIntro: Homebrew installs both tools MP4Flow needs: FFmpeg and ffprobe.
installStepThree: In MP4Flow, select Environment Check → Recheck.
installHelp: No Homebrew? Install it first and complete its Next steps:
